tips.text: Kill a Teralyst and break every Synovia joint; each joint drops a core, so two Teralysts cover the five you need.
Farm Caliban at the same time if you want him; his parts use the same Isoplast, shards and cores.
Expect the Narmer Isoplast and Anomaly Shards to take a session or two; the research and build are the easy part.
